title: DNA Structure, Cloning and the History of Genetics

flashcard_questions.q: Deoxyribonucleic acid — the molecule that carries the genetic instructions for the development, functioning, and reproduction of all living organisms.
The organelle in a eukaryotic cell that contains the cell’s genetic material (DNA) organised into chromosomes.
A large molecule made by joining many smaller molecules (monomers) together in a chain. DNA is a polymer of nucleotides.

flashcard_questions.a: The repeating monomer unit of DNA, consisting of a sugar, a phosphate group, and one of four bases (A, T, C, or G).
The twisted ladder shape of a DNA molecule, formed by two strands of nucleotides wound around each other.
